attempts.summary: Deployed a 4-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-node4, MariaDB 10.11.18 on CentOS Stream 10). Bootstrapped a 3-node cluster (node1,2,3) holding an appdb.orders table, then added node4 which received the existing data via SST (mariabackup) and now accepts writes replicated to all members. Fixed two environment issues along the way: wrong Galera provider library path (galera-4 -> galera) and an SELinux AVC denial blocking mariadb-backup's socket connection (resolved via a generated/installed local policy module). All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time (native systemd reboot), each confirmed via changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, and the cluster was verified to reach full 4-node quorum with all data intact after each restart, with a final cross-node write/read check confirming end-to-end consistency.
